title: Jesus Walks on the Water
reflectionQuestion: When something feels scary, who helps you feel safe again?
kidSafetyNotes: Wonder + anxious->safe. Storm/Peter-sinking handled as awe not terror; rescue is immediate ('right away... before Peter could sink any lower'). Softened for 4-7: 'why did you doubt?' (Matt 14:31) -> 'Why were you afraid? I am right here with you.'; the disciples' 'ghost' -> 'What is it?'. One indelible image: Jesus's hand catching Peter the instant he calls.
